FMC Media PC 0.3.10 — 4KHDHub Direct

- Added the built-in 4KHDHub provider to All and Direct, alongside the existing sources. Its public HubDrive and HubCloud links work without a TorBox key.
- Matches the movie title, type and year, or the exact series season and episode. Lists individual releases with filename, quality and size; excludes season packs and other episodes.
- Generates fresh playback links on selection and validates video bytes and the filename when supplied by the host. HTML landing pages and deleted files are not returned as playable video.
- Preserves installed addons, keys, Arabic Sources, library and playback settings.

Public hosts can take several seconds to generate a link. Available quality, HDR/Dolby Vision output and audio depend on the release and device.

Validation: the packaged source engine returned 12 Direct options for Dexter: Resurrection S02E01; mpv decoded the selected 3832×1600 HEVC release. Interstellar returned 18 options. Python, UI and Rust tests passed.

Install over the current version without uninstalling.
